checks: The editor is compact, anchored and nonmodal; one field opens by default, dirty Close keeps the draft, and Save returns focus with hidden metadata preserved.
Plus adds beneath its own card; the separate chevron only collapses or expands.
Keyboard Add works, and another card cannot steal an unsaved draft or change its parent.
The branch chooser is anchored and nonmodal; Escape returns focus and outside dismissal writes nothing.
One click applies a type to the selected branch, closes the chooser and preserves deeper overrides.
A delayed type save pauses selection and editing; after it finishes, fresh wording saves with hidden notes preserved.
A same-node conflict blocks stale hidden fields; unrelated remote edits still merge safely.
Standalone export keeps direct editing and the complete state without changing the live session.
The direct controls and short chooser work at 390px without script errors.
